harmful_chemicals.name: Parabens (Methylparaben, Propylparaben)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Endocrine disruptor, mimics estrogen. Linked to breast cancer.
harmful_chemicals.herbal_alt: Grapefruit Seed Extract, Vitamin E oil

harmful_chemicals.name: Sodium Lauryl Sulfate (SLS)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Strips natural oils, causes dryness, irritation.

harmful_chemicals.name: Synthetic Fragrance
harmful_chemicals.reason: Leading cause of allergies, headaches and respiratory issues.

harmful_chemicals.name: Phthalates
harmful_chemicals.reason: Linked to reproductive damage, hormonal disruption.

harmful_chemicals.name: Triclosan
harmful_chemicals.reason: Antimicrobial that may affect thyroid hormones.

harmful_chemicals.name: Formaldehyde
harmful_chemicals.reason: Known carcinogen; causes skin irritation and respiratory issues.

harmful_chemicals.name: Hydroquinone
harmful_chemicals.reason: Skin-lightening agent that can cause ochronosis and organ toxicity.
harmful_chemicals.herbal_alt: Turmeric, Liquorice root extract, Kojic acid (natural)

harmful_chemicals.name: Mineral Oil (Paraffinum Liquidum)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Clogs pores, prevents skin from breathing naturally.

harmful_chemicals.name: Diethanolamine (DEA)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Can react to form nitrosamines, a known carcinogen.

harmful_chemicals.name: Oxybenzone
harmful_chemicals.reason: Chemical sunscreen linked to hormone disruption and coral reef damage.
harmful_chemicals.herbal_alt: Zinc oxide, Carrot seed oil (natural SPF)

harmful_chemicals.name: Lead (Pb)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Neurotoxin found in some lipsticks and hair dyes.

harmful_chemicals.name: Toluene
harmful_chemicals.reason: Petrochemical solvent; affects nervous system and causes birth defects.

harmful_chemicals.name: Propylene Glycol
harmful_chemicals.reason: Skin irritant at high concentrations; allows deeper chemical penetration.

harmful_chemicals.name: Benzophenone
harmful_chemicals.reason: UV filter linked to endocrine disruption and organ toxicity.
harmful_chemicals.herbal_alt: Raspberry seed oil, Shea butter (natural SPF)

harmful_chemicals.name: Coal Tar
harmful_chemicals.reason: Known carcinogen used in anti-dandruff shampoos and dark hair dyes.

harmful_chemicals.name: Butylated Hydroxyanisole (BHA)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Preservative classified as possible human carcinogen.

harmful_chemicals.name: Silicone (Dimethicone)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Creates a barrier trapping dirt and bacteria; not easily biodegradable.

harmful_chemicals.name: Ammonia
harmful_chemicals.reason: Harsh chemical in hair dyes causing scalp burns and respiratory irritation.

harmful_chemicals.name: Aluminum Compounds (Aluminium Chlorohydrate)
harmful_chemicals.reason: Used in antiperspirants; linked to breast cancer and Alzheimer's risk.
harmful_chemicals.herbal_alt: Crystal deodorant, Baking soda, Witch hazel

harmful_chemicals.name: Isopropyl Alcohol
harmful_chemicals.reason: Drying agent that strips skin of moisture and natural protection.
